entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge (POCSO), Bhubaneswar (Circuit Court at Khurda
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Having regard to the allegations in the F.I.R., there appears material in the case with regard to the offence under the POCSO Act and as such it is not desirable for this Court to grant anticipatory bail.

However, it is directed that in the event the Petitioners surrender and move for bail before the learned court below, the learned court in seisin over the matter shall dispose of // 2 // the bail application on its own merit being alive of the position of law on bail keeping in view the gravity of the offences taking into consideration the materials on record as well as other documents available on record, as far as possible on the same day, without being influenced by any observations made by this Court.
4. It is made clear that the court shall apply its own wisdom in allowing or rejecting the bail.
